encounter: E0208 TRAINER_MEL_AND_PAUL (Route109, Feather Badge - optional Surf backtrack, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: Route 109 is the Slateport beach, reachable on the Surf backtrack after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: Torracat line (36), New Mauville entrance via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Sneasel (14), Togepi Route 102 plus Shiny Stone (24), AlteringCave_1F (14), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20). All precede the Surf backtrack. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: Four bugs behind two Pranksters and a Baton Pass chain. The single most important fact is that Prankster's priority does not apply to status moves aimed at a Dark-type, so Incineroar, Weavile and Spiritomb each turn off the Encore and the priority half of Illumise's and Volbeat's kit by existing. Incineroar is also the damage answer - Fire is 2x on all four - and its Fake Out denies the opening Tailwind or Tail Glow turn. Magnezone is the wall: Steel resists Bug Buzz, Hurricane, Giga Drain and Dazzling Gleam and is outright immune to Sludge Bomb, so nothing Mel and Paul own hits it for even neutral damage, while Thunderbolt is 2x back into Mega Butterfree. Togekiss's Flying is 2x on the whole team. The thing to break is the chain: Volbeat's Prankster Tail Glow is a three-stage Special Attack boost that Baton Passes into a Compound Eyes Mega Butterfree whose Hurricane then cannot miss, so the pass receiver - not the passer - is where the pressure belongs.
